name: Ariadne
description: Bidirectional XML-RPC sync between Binary Ninja, GDB/pwndbg, and Julia.
longdescription: Ariadne runs a localhost XML-RPC server inside Binary Ninja. It exports renamed functions, stack variables, and types; consumes the live PC and breakpoints from a pwndbg client; and keeps the UI thread free by serving analysis from a cache and applying highlights asynchronously.
